verified_claims.claim: scene flow uses depth at t and t+1 plus 2D optical flow
JA appears every three layers for 10 modules
shared JA KV reduces projection cost from 18d2 to 12d2
w/o 4D pretraining AEPE is 0.729 versus full 0.170
w/o RoPE AEPE is 0.210 and shared FFN AEPE is 0.280
total latency is 1106 ms and world model is 990 ms
planning rate is about 0.9 Hz while effective action rate is about 9 Hz
Lid Placement and Bowl Stacking are each 65.71 percent

interpretive_boundaries: RGB-DF is called projective 4D because it remains 2D-aligned; it is not a persistent explicit 4D field.
The paper does not establish complete hidden-surface or multi-view geometry.
The 9 Hz number is action-chunk throughput, not visual replanning frequency.
AEPE in this paper is measured on normalized RGB flow visualizations and is not directly comparable to standard pixel EPE.
Pseudo depth and flow inherit teacher-model biases; no claim of sensor-ground-truth 4D is made.
Causal explanations for foundation-model failure in Hand-over are author hypotheses rather than separately controlled experiments.
